g.text: P1: parent-wise changes distinguish physical coverage from extra directions

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #444444

g.text: Eight diagnostic parents · all six intervals and four withheld directions per parent · negative values indicate improvement
Each point compares the same physical parent before and after scaling; each parent is one observation.
RMS change = 100 × (after / before − 1). No confidence interval, repeated-cohort estimate or significance claim.
